name: Moroccan Carrot Soup
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical soup recipes using ~750g vegetables plus water/stock to produce 4 modest servings

Total time is sum of explicit roast (12 min), plus conservative estimates for preheat (5 min), mixing/transfer (3 min), cooling/grinding/straining (8 min), simmering (5 min), and final seasoning (2 min)
All ingredients plant-based with no animal products listed
No gluten-containing grains or wheat products listed
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, or peanuts listed
Sesame ambiguous as some garam masala blends can optionally include sesame but not specified here
Cumin and coriander interpreted as whole seeds per instructions; garam masala as powder per instructions
No compound sauces or ambiguous processed items beyond listed spices
instructions:
Step 1
Preheat oven to 180° C.
Step 2
Combine carrots, onion, garlic, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, salt and olive oil in a bowl and mix well. Transfer on a baking tray.
Step 3
Put the baking tray in preheated oven and roast for 10-12 minutes or till carrots soften. Remove from heat and cool.
Step 4
Grind the baked carrot mixture along with some water to make a smooth paste and strain in a bowl.
Step 5
Heat the carrot mixture in a non-stick pan. Add two cups of water and bring to a boil. Add garam masala powder and mix. Add salt and mix well.
Step 6
Remove from heat, add lemon juice and mix well.
Step 7
Serve hot.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 6 medium carrots, chopped, total edible weight ~600g; raw values used as roasted without added fat beyond listed oil

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion, sliced, ~110g edible portion; raw values

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 4 typical garlic cloves, total ~12g; raw values

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp whole cumin seeds, ~2g; typical spice nutrition

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp coriander seeds, ~1g; typical spice nutrition

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbs olive oil, ~14g; standard oil values

ingredients.name: Garam Masala
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 tsp garam masala powder, ~0.5g; typical blended spice estimate

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp fresh lemon juice, ~5g; standard citrus juice values
